Criteria.TestCondition: The focus order preserves the meaning and operability of the web page.
DisabilityImpact: With Limited Language, Cognitive, and Learning Abilities
Criteria.TesterComment: Keyboard focus moves through the page in an order that follows how it reads, forward and backward. The focus order departs from the reading order (focus jumps back up the page from "Contact" (link) to "DATA SEARCH" (link); focus jumps back up the page from "Science Explorer Digital Library" (link) to "DATA SITES" (link); focus jumps back up the page from "Planetary Science" (link) to "ACROSS" (link)), but it still makes sense: Header, skip link, form fields and buttons follow a logical order. Footer columns are read one after another. The flagged jumps are just moves to the next column, and the Data Sites links continue in a second column.. If you disagree, tell your assistant.
